title: Failure bits for reciprocal parameters
statement: Let $\delta$ be a rational number with $0<\delta\leq 1/2$, and let $d$ be a positive natural number. If $\delta=1/d$, then the failure-bit count $\lceil\log_2\lceil 2/\delta\rceil\rceil$ equals $\lceil\log_2(2d)\rceil$.
